sheets.prompt: Cinematic key frame for a science fiction exploration game: in a dim stone room, an ancient makers' chest on the floor has just opened, a hip-high rounded shell of pale cream ceramic like a smooth river stone with a thin brass band round its middle and a round glass lens of jade-green fluid in the band at the front; its upper shell has parted in two halves on side hinges like petals, their insides lined in pale jade and glowing. Real light pours straight up out of the opening: a soft-edged column of warm pale gold and jade light widening upward, a few long god rays fanning out of it, the light drawn as two or three flat bands of colour, brightest at the core; soft dust motes drifting in the beam. The light glows on the undersides of the open halves and inside the chest, and lights the face, hands and chest of a cloaked adult traveller with a round glass backpack of jade fluid who stands just in front of it looking down into it, a warm pool of light on the floor round the chest, long soft shadows behind him. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, cream ceramic, brass, jade green and pale gold light, cool blue-violet shadows, restrained cream paper grain, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, pirate treasure chest, padlock, lens flare.
sheets.why: Picked (issue #285, chosen by the agent as asked): the game's own chest (cream shell, brass band, jade lens, halves on side hinges) and the clearest structure of light: a pale gold core widening into a few flat jade bands with straight-edged rays fanning out, the lining glowing, a warm pool on the floor and light on the traveller's front, sparse motes. The other dark-room candidate fans wider and reads as a spotlight; the daylight ones show the column but not the pool or the lit face.
